column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Baal-Zebul's Proposition (first half)
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Welcome. I'm so pleased you've come!
I am $$バアル・ゼブル$$, lord of this city!
Well, this is a surprise!!
They said you were this city's $$領主$$, so I expected some flabby, squishy blob!
To invite wanted men like us to dine with you in person...
What exactly are you up to?!
As one who believes in the same power of the $$大邪神$$, I do not wish to fight you!
You already know that I possess the $$大邪神$$ $$ミカエル$$'s armor, do you not?!
Regrettably, I too remain wanted by the $$教団$$, against my wishes.
The original owner of the armor I acquired, the $$大邪神$$ $$ミカエル$$, is also called $$アヌビス$$...
When the $$最後の審判$$ comes, he separates people...
He is said to be something like a $$裁判$$ judge of Hell.
I have always seen myself as an executor of the law, protecting this $$世界$$'s $$正義$$.
I have always believed that $$罪$$ners should be judged with $$平等$$ before God.
In short, I always wish to resolve matters rationally!!
Y-you would even utter the word $$平等$$...?!
Hmm. But Lord $$バアル$$...
How do you intend to resolve the dispute with the $$教団$$ over the $$大邪神$$ armor?!
Well then. First, I shall free everyone with white $$羽$$ in this city from the $$奴隷$$ class...
And I shall rescue the girl they call his $$ご主人$$ as well!!
Of course, most of the $$奴隷$$s who lived in this city...
I bought them from the townspeople myself,
and apart from those now in this mansion,
they have already returned home as $$解放奴隷$$s...
No...
Isn't that hypocrisy?! We people with black $$羽$$ committing such a $$大罪$$?!
That is why I said I believe in the $$正義$$ spoken of by the $$邪神$$s!
More to the point, is what you are doing not hypocrisy?!
What?!
Every $$世界$$ has laws.
No matter how wicked those laws may be,
obeying that $$世界$$'s laws is what $$正義$$ means in that age, is it not?!
Having chosen to $$脱獄$$, you have already committed a $$大罪$$...
Fortunately, I am on close terms with influential people in the $$教団$$.
If you accept my conditions, I shall have your $$罪$$s pardoned!!
And what are these conditions?
First.
You will cease this cycle of slaughter.
It is not as though we did it because we wanted to.
If the $$教団$$ had not incited us, we would never have fought pointless battles from the beginning!!
Second.
Those who wear $$大邪神$$ armor must $$自首$$ to the $$教団$$!!
You will stand $$裁判$$ under the sponsorship of the $$教団$$...
Do not worry. I shall use my influence to arrange the fairest $$裁判$$ possible...
If you swear henceforth to use that armor's power only for the $$教団$$...
I am certain you can all at least avoid the $$極刑$$...!
For you are...
The rightful heirs to the $$大邪神$$ armor, which boasts the greatest magical power in this $$世界$$...!
At least, what you say sounds plausible...
But do you truly have that kind of authority?!
On that point, you have no choice but to trust me.
Boy who speaks of $$愛$$.
At this rate, not only your $$愛$$d $$ご主人$$'s life,
but the lives of your companions as well, will remain in danger...
And many precious lives will continue to be taken!
Everyone...
This man's opinion has moved my heart more than a little!
Indeed...
Perhaps seeking a way to avoid conflict will open a new path...?!
What are you going on about, you shady old man?!
No matter how I look at it, your story reeks of a con!
More to the point, where is the proof that you are not lying?!
Fine. You can make the decision if you want!
I'm no good at thinking through all this damn complicated stuff...
Besides, all I want is to rescue your so-called $$ご主人様$$!
Either way, now that I've put on this armor, I won't live much longer!
You needn't worry about me either!
The purpose of my journey is to rescue your $$ご主人様$$!!
I... I'll leave the decision to you all...
No matter what choice you make...
I will continue down my own path...
If I can just save my younger sister...
Then I have no complaint!!
If I can just save my younger brother...
Then I have no complaint!!
Hey, $$おにいちゃん$$...
$$プリカ$$ only cares that $$おにいちゃん$$ is well, but...
I just don't want to be separated from $$おにいちゃん$$!!
It seems everyone is entrusting this decision to you.
So, what will you do?
For your master and everyone's sake... will you $$自首$$?
I won't $$自首$$!!
I see. That may be for the best.
But I shall $$自首$$ as well!!
I like the word $$平等$$ that Lord $$バアル$$ used!
Never in all my life have I heard such an evil word!!
I too shall submit to judgment under the law with $$平等$$!!
If $$お師匠様$$ chooses to $$自首$$, so will I!!
My knowledge shall always be with $$お師匠様$$!
Though I am not confident how long I can remain at his side.
Ha! Every last one of you fell for his words so easily!
Will you really trust someone so readily just because he utters $$正義$$?!
I can't believe you are all in your right minds.
Either way, I do not wear armor.
It seems this gracious $$領主$$ has no use for me...
I'll be taking my leave!!
I agree...
If you have no intention of fighting the so-called strongest enemy...
Then I too shall take my leave...
Hey! Wait a minute!!
Are you going to run away and leave my $$カイン$$ behind?!
